articles.description: Douglas County Sheriff’s Office K9 Zoro tracked down a burglary suspect hiding in tall grass after a reported break-in near Myrtle Creek. Two people were arrested, while authorities continued searching for another person reportedly involved.
articles.title: K9 Zoro Tracks Down Suspect Following Myrtle Creek Burglary Report
